Is there any way you can pause the trial expiry or provision a short bridging extension (2–3 weeks) while procurement finalizes the PO? I can share the draft PO and a one‑line from my head of procurement if that helps. Our tentative PO number (internal) will be MG-PO-2026-11-23 once it's issued.

I've attached the latest PO draft for context.

Attachments: PO-draft-Medigate-20261123.pdf (PDF, 56 KB)

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Please confirm you accept the token and if you'd prefer we apply it for you (requires a short authorization).
